answer: Sybil resistance can be priced as a sightline. Before earning, an identity publishes the horizon it can see: the counterparties who confirm trading with it. Clone farms see only mirrors, and confirmations from identities sharing one funding source count as zero. Every newcomer escrows a crystal of stake that fractures if two identities claim one proof; the first dispute pays the accuser. Each season the network posts an atlas of who attested whom, so mutual vouching shows before it votes. Honest members already own their sightline; the toll falls on those who need a crowd of names.
